excerpt.zh: 所有[target.capital_scope.GetName]的[target.GetSpeciesName]重要领袖都被我们的密探调包了。现在渗透人员正在巩固我们在[target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]的进展。是时候采取行动了。
excerpt.en: All [target.GetSpeciesName] leaders of significance on [target.capital_scope.GetName] have been replaced by our own agents. Infiltration cells are now consolidating our efforts on the [target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. The time to act is upon us.

texts.zh: 所有[target.capital_scope.GetName]的[target.GetSpeciesName]重要领袖都被我们的密探调包了。现在渗透人员正在巩固我们在[target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]的进展。是时候采取行动了。
texts.en: All [target.GetSpeciesName] leaders of significance on [target.capital_scope.GetName] have been replaced by our own agents. Infiltration cells are now consolidating our efforts on the [target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. The time to act is upon us.

texts.zh: 我们目前在[target.capital_scope.GetName]有数以千计的秘密特工，并且渗透了[root.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]的各方各面。一些特工已在当地的权力体系中升居高位，并利用自身的职位影响力为其他特工提供便利。
texts.en: Our covert operatives on [target.capital_scope.GetName] now number in the thousands, and have infiltrated every facet of the [root.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. Several have ascended to leading positions in the local hierarchy, and are already wielding the influence of their positions to benefit other agents.

texts.zh:
虽然我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]表面上有数以千计的特工，但进展始终缓慢。我们曾试图推翻一个由[target.GetName]组成的主要定居点，最终惨痛收场。有关特工都已牺牲或自裁。

多亏了一支潜伏小组的英勇之举，当局才没有找到尸体，未能识破我们在星球上的行动。
texts.en:
Although our operatives on the surface of [target.capital_scope.GetName] now number in the thousands, progress has been slow. An attempt to overthrow one of the major settlements comprising the [target.GetName] ended in disaster, and the death or self-termination of every agent involved.

It was only the heroic efforts of a sleeper cell that kept local authorities from recovering the bodies and exposing our work on the planet.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.GetName]中的工作取得了巨大的进展。通过小心地操控文化模因和社会风俗，我们促生了一次影响深远的文化转变，并且几乎让人误认为是完全自发的现象。

我们的特工熟练运用光荣祖先的经验建立了一个[root.GetAdj]威权主义的原始模型。精心筛选的一批当地人被赋权以统治这些社群，其中一些将会繁荣昌盛，另一些则会逐渐凋亡。而这一切都会成为令[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]印象深刻的一课，指导他们学会如何考虑合适的社会组织形式。
texts.en:
Our work in the [from.target.GetName] proceeded splendidly. Through careful manipulation of cultural memes and social mores, we have encouraged a cultural shift so profound, one could almost believe it arose spontaneously.

Our operatives deftly wielded the lessons of our glorious predecessors by establishing primitive models of [root.GetAdj] authoritarianism. A select few influential locals have been empowered to rule over these communities - some of which will prosper, while others will not. All will serve as compelling lessons for the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] as they consider proper social ordering.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.GetName]中的工作取得了巨大的进展。通过小心地操控文化模因和社会风俗，我们促生了一次影响深远的文化转变，并且几乎让人误认为是完全自发的现象。

我们的特工广泛深入基层，与当地社群交流关于公平和平等的事宜。尽管[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]对政治的理解仍停留在启蒙阶段，但我们已经促动了在当地人中的一些进一步讨论的活动。[from.GetName]行动已经结束，我们会将自主权留给当地的支持者，让他们自行寻找通向个人主义的道路。
texts.en:
Our work in the [from.target.GetName] proceeded splendidly. Through careful manipulation of cultural memes and social mores, we have encouraged a cultural shift so profound, one could almost believe it arose spontaneously.

Our operatives traveled far and wide, engaging local communities in matters such as equity and fairness. Although [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] political understanding remains in its infancy, we have inspired some to campaign for further debate amongst their own people. With Operation [from.GetName] now concluded, we leave it to local advocates like these to find their own path to egalitarianism.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.GetName]中的工作取得了巨大的进展。通过小心地操控文化模因和社会风俗，我们促生了一次影响深远的文化转变，并且几乎让人误认为是完全自发的现象。

我们精挑细选的特工在艺术和教育思辨方面造诣颇深，他们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]上启蒙着各个社群。他们针对各种不同的[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]文化因材施教，以沙龙、文艺作品和教育机构的形式结出了累累硕果。这些唯物主义工具已经遗赠给了[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
texts.en:
Our work in the [from.target.GetName] proceeded splendidly. Through careful manipulation of cultural memes and social mores, we have encouraged a cultural shift so profound, one could almost believe it arose spontaneously.

Our select group of operatives - all highly skilled in the art of educational debate - worked to enlighten community groups across the [from.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. Adapting each lesson for the myriad forms of [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] culture, their efforts bore fruit in the form of salons, artworks, and educational institutions. These materialist tools have now been bequeathed to the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.GetName]中的工作取得了巨大的进展。通过小心地操控文化模因和社会风俗，我们促生了一次影响深远的文化转变，并且几乎让人误认为是完全自发的现象。

现如今，在许多[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的文化中，荣誉和勇敢已经成了头等大事。我们的特工伪装成雇佣兵、起义军和军火商，用精美的仪式性武器、绚丽的战斗技术和一系列精心设计的遭遇战让当地人惊掉了下巴。这一切都在启发着一个更加军国主义的[from.target.GetName]。
texts.en:
Our work in the [from.target.GetName] proceeded splendidly. Through careful manipulation of cultural memes and social mores, we have encouraged a cultural shift so profound, one could almost believe it arose spontaneously.

Honor and prowess have taken pride of place in a number of [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] cultures. Our operatives - posing as mercenaries, rebels, and suppliers to military causes - succeeded in dazzling locals with ceremonial weaponry, ornate combat drills, and a number of carefully-orchestrated skirmishes. All now serve as inspirations for a more militaristic [from.target.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.GetName]中的工作取得了巨大的进展。通过小心地操控文化模因和社会风俗，我们促生了一次影响深远的文化转变，并且几乎让人误认为是完全自发的现象。

我们精挑细选的特工在调停技能方面造诣颇深，他们在当地众多群体中斡旋，针对许多[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的社会顽疾开出了[root.GetAdj]和平主义良药。如今，这些社群眼中暴力已经不再是第一选择了。
texts.en:
Our work in the [from.target.GetName] proceeded splendidly. Through careful manipulation of cultural memes and social mores, we have encouraged a cultural shift so profound, one could almost believe it arose spontaneously.

Our select group of operatives - all highly skilled mediators - mingled with a diverse set of communities, demonstrating the value of [root.GetAdj] pacifism as the solution to many [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] social ills. For these communes at least, violence is no longer their first response.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.GetName]中的工作取得了巨大的进展。通过小心地操控文化模因和社会风俗，我们促生了一次影响深远的文化转变，并且几乎让人误认为是完全自发的现象。

我们的特工全面推动工作进展，用故事、艺术和群体活动的方式促进了对其他文化的的好奇和欣赏。如今[from.GetName]行动已经结束了，我们的特工对当地的亲外主义者寄予厚望，希望它们能延续讨论，让[from.target.GetName]做好一个在多元化宇宙中生活的准备。
texts.en:
Our work in the [from.target.GetName] proceeded splendidly. Through careful manipulation of cultural memes and social mores, we have encouraged a cultural shift so profound, one could almost believe it arose spontaneously.

Our operatives took a holistic approach, encouraging curiosity and a greater appreciation for other cultures in the form of stories, art, and community events. With Operation [from.GetName] now concluded, our operatives have left it to local xenophiles to keep these discussions alive, and better prepare the [from.target.GetName] for life in a diverse galaxy.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.GetName]中的工作取得了巨大的进展。通过小心地操控文化模因和社会风俗，我们促生了一次影响深远的文化转变，并且几乎让人误认为是完全自发的现象。

恐惧和猜疑很容易因冲动而起，但却很难控制。我们的特工小心翼翼地编撰演讲和艺术作品来展示关于自我保存的积极一面，并教导他们外来影响的危险性。[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的拥护者们在排外议题上对特工们的课程很是受用。
texts.en:
Our work in the [from.target.GetName] proceeded splendidly. Through careful manipulation of cultural memes and social mores, we have encouraged a cultural shift so profound, one could almost believe it arose spontaneously.

As impulses go, fear and mistrust are easily encouraged but are difficult to manage. Our operatives were careful to ensure their speeches and cultural works showcased the positive aspects of self-preservation, as much as they taught pointed lessons about the dangers of alien influence. Their lessons have now been taken up by [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] champions for xenophobic interests.

我们双管齐下，让一群颇具魅力的特工去领导一些基于当地信仰的教派，又派另一群特工保护这些蓬勃发展的运动不受政治的干扰和排挤。这些开化了的[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社群已经接纳了某种基于当地文化的唯心主义。他们会独自走向神圣的道路。
texts.en:
Our work in the [from.target.GetName] proceeded splendidly. Through careful manipulation of cultural memes and social mores, we have encouraged a cultural shift so profound, one could almost believe it arose spontaneously.

Our two-pronged approach placed one group of charismatic operatives at the head of cults and sects based on various indigenous faiths, while another worked to protect these burgeoning movements from political interference and ridicule. These communities of enlightened [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] have now embraced a form of spiritualism which is native to their own culture. They walk their own path towards the Divine.

texts.en:
Time alone will show how lasting our effect may be on the [from.target.GetAdj], however initial projections look promising. [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] advocates have already taken up our ideas as keenly as if they were their own.

Our operatives wielded the lessons handed down to us by our glorious predecessors, establishing miniature models of [root.GetAdj] authoritarianism on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. Certain institutions have been remodeled, arranging many [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] into carefully-designed hierarchies. Not all these communities will last, but their failures will serve as valuable lessons, strengthening their social order overall.

texts.zh:
尽管一开始的势头看起来颇为靠谱，但只有时间能告诉我们对[from.target.GetAdj]的努力能维持多久。[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]拥护者们已经彻底接纳了我们的意识形态，视如己出。

我们的特工广泛深入基层，与当地社群和机构交流关于公平和平等的事宜。[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的政治科学已经趋于成熟，但我们还是促动了一些运动，以推动更具包容性的辩论和平等主义政策。
texts.en:
Time alone will show how lasting our effect may be on the [from.target.GetAdj], however initial projections look promising. [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] advocates have already taken up our ideas as keenly as if they were their own.

Our operatives traveled far and wide, engaging local communities and institutions in matters such as equity and fairness. [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] political sciences are already fairly mature, but we have set multiple campaigns in motion which are already pushing for more inclusive debate and egalitarian policies.

Our select group of operatives - all highly skilled in the art of educational debate - worked to enlighten community groups and educational institutions across the [from.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. Their efforts have led to the establishment of research centers, educational funds, and even a new art movement. These tools of materialism have now been bequeathed to the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Time alone will show how lasting our effect may be on the [from.target.GetAdj], however initial projections look promising. [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] advocates have already taken up our ideas as keenly as if they were their own.

Honor and prowess have taken pride of place in a number of [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] cultures. Our operatives - posing as mercenaries, rebels, and suppliers to military causes - succeeded in dazzling locals with ceremonial weaponry, ornate combat drills, and a number of carefully-orchestrated skirmishes. All now serve as inspirations for a more militaristic [from.target.GetName].

我们精挑细选的特工在调停技能方面造诣颇深，他们在当地众多群体中斡旋，针对许多[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的社会顽疾开出了[root.GetAdj]和平主义良药。如今，这些社群眼中暴力已经不再是第一选择了。

Time alone will show how lasting our effect may be on the [from.target.GetAdj], however initial projections look promising. [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] advocates have already taken up our ideas as keenly as if they were their own.

Our operatives took a holistic approach, encouraging curiosity and a greater appreciation for other cultures in the form of stories, art, and community events. With Operation [from.GetName] now concluded, our operatives have left it to local xenophiles to keep these discussions alive, and better prepare the [from.target.GetName] for life in a diverse galaxy.

Time alone will show how lasting our effect may be on the [from.target.GetAdj], however initial projections look promising. [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] advocates have already taken up our ideas as keenly as if they were their own.

Fear and mistrust are easily encouraged but are difficult to steer, especially in a society with access to mass media. Our operatives employed a delicate touch, planting xenophobic speeches and cultural movements which showcased the positive aspects of self-preservation, as much as they taught pointed lessons about the dangers of alien influence. Their lessons have now been taken up by homegrown [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] champions and political groups.

Our select group of operatives - all highly skilled in the art of educational debate - worked to enlighten community groups and educational institutions across the [from.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. Their efforts have led to the establishment of research centers, educational funds, and even a new art movement. These tools of materialism have now been bequeathed to the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.GetName]中的工作并非一帆风顺，但还是成功了。尽管我们的努力并没有如预期般吸引到那么多的当地的支持者，但还是取得了一些正面的成果。

现如今，在许多[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的文化中，荣誉和勇敢已经成了头等大事。我们的特工伪装成雇佣兵、起义军和军火商，用精美的仪式性武器、绚丽的战斗技术和一系列精心设计的遭遇战让当地人惊掉了下巴。这一切都在启发着一个更加军国主义的[from.target.GetName]。
texts.en:
Our work in the [from.target.GetName] was not without its challenges, but we have succeeded. While our efforts did not attract as many homegrown advocates as first hoped, we have achieved some positive results.

Honor and prowess have taken pride of place in a number of [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] cultures. Our operatives - posing as mercenaries, rebels, and suppliers to military causes - succeeded in dazzling locals with ceremonial weaponry, ornate combat drills, and a number of carefully-orchestrated skirmishes. All now serve as inspirations for a more militaristic [from.target.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.GetName]中的工作并非一帆风顺，但还是成功了。尽管我们的努力并没有如预期般吸引到那么多的当地的支持者，但还是取得了一些正面的成果。

我们精挑细选的特工在调停技能方面造诣颇深，他们在当地众多群体中斡旋，针对许多[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的社会顽疾开出了[root.GetAdj]和平主义良药。如今，这些社群眼中暴力已经不再是第一选择了。
texts.en:
Our work in the [from.target.GetName] was not without its challenges, but we have succeeded. While our efforts did not attract as many homegrown advocates as first hoped, we have achieved some positive results.

Our select group of operatives - all highly skilled mediators - mingled with a diverse set of communities, demonstrating the value of [root.GetAdj] pacifism as the solution to many [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] social ills. For these communes at least, violence is no longer their first response.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.GetName]中的工作并非一帆风顺，但还是成功了。尽管我们的努力并没有如预期般吸引到那么多的当地的支持者，但还是取得了一些正面的成果。

我们的特工全面推动工作进展，用故事、艺术和群体活动的方式促进了对其他文化的的好奇和欣赏。如今[from.GetName]行动已经结束了，我们的特工对当地的亲外主义者寄予厚望，希望它们能延续讨论，让[from.target.GetName]做好一个在多元化宇宙中生活的准备。
texts.en:
Our work in the [from.target.GetName] was not without its challenges, but we have succeeded. While our efforts did not attract as many homegrown advocates as first hoped, we have achieved some positive results.

Our operatives took a holistic approach, encouraging curiosity and a greater appreciation for other cultures in the form of stories, art, and community events. With Operation [from.GetName] now concluded, our operatives have left it to local xenophiles to keep these discussions alive, and better prepare the [from.target.GetName] for life in a diverse galaxy.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.GetName]中的工作并非一帆风顺，但还是成功了。尽管我们的努力并没有如预期般吸引到那么多的当地的支持者，但还是取得了一些正面的成果。

恐惧和猜疑很容易因冲动而起，但却很难控驾驭，特别是对这么一个已经大规模接入媒体的社会而言更是如此。我们的特工潜移默化地将排外主义说辞和展现自我保存积极面的文化运动根植于此地，并教导他们外来影响的危险性。[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的拥护者和政治群体对特工们的课程很是受用。
texts.en:
Our work in the [from.target.GetName] was not without its challenges, but we have succeeded. While our efforts did not attract as many homegrown advocates as first hoped, we have achieved some positive results.

Fear and mistrust are easily encouraged but are difficult to steer, especially in a society with access to mass media. Our operatives employed a delicate touch, planting xenophobic speeches and cultural movements which showcased the positive aspects of self-preservation, as much as they taught pointed lessons about the dangers of alien influence. Their lessons have now been taken up by homegrown [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] champions and political groups.

我们在[from.target.GetName]中的工作并非一帆风顺，但还是成功了。尽管我们的努力并没有如预期般吸引到那么多的当地的支持者，但还是取得了一些正面的成果。

我们双管齐下，让一群颇具魅力的特工去领导一些基于当地信仰的教派，又派另一群特工保护这些蓬勃发展的运动不受政治的干扰和排挤。这些开化了的[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社群已经接纳了某种基于当地文化的唯心主义。他们会独自走向神圣的道路。
texts.en:
Our work in the [from.target.GetName] was not without its challenges, but we have succeeded. While our efforts did not attract as many homegrown advocates as first hoped, we have achieved some positive results.

Our two-pronged approach placed one group of charismatic operatives at the head of cults and sects based on various indigenous faiths, while another worked to protect these burgeoning movements from political interference and ridicule. These communities of enlightened [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] have now embraced a form of spiritualism which is native to their own culture. They walk their own path towards the Divine.
